title: Best 1.5 Ton AC Under ₹45,000 in India (2026): 5 Inverter Split ACs Ranked
description: Ranked: the 5 best 1.5 ton inverter split ACs under ₹45,000 in India for 2026. Compare ISEER, copper coils, Wi-Fi and noise across LG, Voltas, Daikin and more.
short_desc: Five inverter split ACs that cool a 150 sq ft room cheaply -- and one to skip.

headings.text: What actually matters in a 1.5 ton AC under ₹45,000
Our picks: 5 inverter split ACs that actually save electricity

cta.headline: Want the full spreadsheet?
cta.sub: Compare 30+ 1.5 ton ACs side-by-side -- ISEER, noise in dB, cooling at 45°C ambient, real user complaints.

faq.q: Is 1.5 ton enough for my room?
faq.a: Yes, for rooms between 120 and 180 sq ft. For smaller rooms (under 100 sq ft) get a 1 ton; for larger rooms (200+ sq ft) get a 2 ton. The right size matters more than the brand.

faq.q: What is ISEER and what is a good rating?
faq.a: ISEER is the Indian Seasonal Energy Efficiency Ratio -- higher is more efficient. 5-star ISEER ACs use about 30% less electricity than 3-star. Aim for ISEER 5.0+ in this bracket.
Yes. Copper coils last longer, cool faster, and are easier to repair than aluminium. Every pick on this list uses copper.

faq.q: How much electricity does a 1.5 ton AC use?
faq.a: A 5-star inverter 1.5 ton AC uses about 0.8-1.2 units per hour of active cooling. At ₹7/unit, that's roughly ₹6-9 per hour of use -- or about ₹2,000-3,000 per year if you run it 6 hours daily for 6 months.

tldr_pick: The LG 1.5 Ton 5 Star DUAL Inverter Split AC (PS-Q19YNZE) is the best 1.5 ton AC under ₹45,000 in India -- 6-in-1 convertible cooling, AI mode, and the quietest compressor in the bracket at 39 dB. Buy it at ₹42,990 on Amazon.
key_takeaways: 5-star ISEER saves ₹1,000+ per year: a 5-star vs 3-star 1.5 ton AC pays back the price difference within 2 summers.
Skip the Lloyd 1.5 ton 5-star 2024 model: ₹42,990 for noisy operation and weak service network.
Copper coils are non-negotiable: aluminium coils corrode in coastal cities within 4 years.
Wi-Fi is now standard: 4 of the 5 picks support app control from your phone.
who_for: Anyone buying a 1.5 ton split AC for a bedroom or living room between 120 and 180 sq ft. If you're replacing a 5+ year old AC, upgrading to a 5-star inverter will cut your summer electricity bill by ₹1,000-2,000 per year. If you're buying your first AC, focus on noise (you'll sleep next to it) and service network (you'll need it within 3 years).
methodology: We compared 8 inverter split ACs priced ₹36,990 to ₹44,990 on Amazon India and Flipkart in September 2026. For each, we evaluated ISEER star rating, noise level in dB, copper coil confirmation, Wi-Fi features, warranty length, and brand service network. Picks were cross-checked against BEE's 2026 database and current sale pricing on Flipkart's AC Sale Week.
